entities.summary: Brian L. Roberts is an American entrepreneur, business executive and billionaire. He is the chairman and CEO of Comcast, a multinational telecommunications and media company providing entertainment and communications products and services, founded by his father, Ralph J. Roberts. He was named president of Comcast in 1990 before becoming the CEO in 2002.
